name: Scared
overview: Scripture teaches that fear should not dominate the believer’s heart because the LORD God is present, mighty, and faithful to uphold His people. Even in daunting circumstances, such as facing overwhelming enemies, God’s presence and deliverance provide confidence and strength, as seen in Deuteronomy 7:21 and 20:1. Trusting fully in the LORD rather than our own understanding (Proverbs 3:5) and relying on Christ as the only way to the Father (John 14:6) anchors believers in hope. Furthermore, God promises to strengthen, help, and uphold His people (Isaiah 41:10), assuring that all things work together for good for those who love Him (Romans 8:28), dispelling fear through His sovereign care.
